bullets.bullet_text: Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing engagements, structuring traceable scenarios, challenger model variants, and model-risk remediation with governance-grade evidence for regulated institutions.

Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing programs, structuring traceable scenario and challenger-model frameworks alongside model-risk remediation to produce audit-grade governance evidence for regulators.

Architected enterprise risk-management operating models aligned to BCBS 239, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics across risk-data aggregation programs.
